title: Rotterdam cold snap -> TTF returns
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Rotterdam temperature anomaly 10d z-score < -1 (European cold snap) leads TTF log returns by 1 day (-anomaly, +price); trade long TTF=F 5d [weather.rotterdam.temp_anomaly -> finance.TTF=F.log_return]
message: Not supported: Rotterdam temp anomaly vs TTF log returns r=0.026 (n=388, best lag 2d r=0.13, validity 0/10, supported_prob 0); rubric long rule 39 trades excess -0.03%/trade, OOS war period negative (n=12, avg -0.14%). No tradeable edge.

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.rotterdam.temp_anomaly rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Rotterdam daily max wind 20d z-score > 1 (North Sea wind surge, more wind power, less gas burn) leads TTF log returns by 2 days (+wind, -price); trade TTF=F 2d [weather.rotterdam.wind_max -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0025)
